title: curator media center config
description: Stored as $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/curator/config.json of the media center user. Written by the admin interface (admin/src/config.ts), read by the media center (src/config.rs). Change both sides together and bump `version` for incompatible changes. Version 1 files (one home screen, everything at the top level) are still read and converted into one home screen "Home" (id "home"), then written as version 2.

home_screens.description: At least one; exactly one has "default": true.

parental.description: PIN (one for all home screens). Missing fields take their defaults.

pin_hash.description: argon2 PHC hash of the 4-8 digit PIN, set via the admin interface (POST /api/pin). Never the PIN itself.

pin_length.description: Number of PIN digits (only together with pin_hash), so the lock screen checks the PIN as soon as it is complete.

pin_backoff_doubling.description: After a wrong PIN wait 5 s; with this option the wait doubles after each further wrong PIN (max 1 h).

screensaver.description: Screensaver of the media center's own screens (not over a running player or website). While one is set up, the media center also keeps the computer from blanking the screen. Missing fields take their defaults.

mode.description: title: the title moves slowly over a very dark background whose color changes a little every minute. aerial: the chosen aerial videos in random order (falls back to title while none is downloaded).

idle_minutes.description: Minutes without input before the screensaver starts.

aerial_quality.description: Which file of each aerial video is downloaded. Videos that only exist in 4K use their 4K file.

aerial_videos.description: Ids of the chosen aerial videos (from AerialWindows/Aerial's videos.json). The admin interface downloads them to $XDG_CACHE_HOME/curator/aerial/<id>.<quality>.mov.

statistics.description: Usage statistics (src/stats.rs). Missing fields take their defaults.

enabled.description: Record what is used when (stays on this computer).

keep_days.description: Older days are deleted when the media center starts or is unlocked.

items.description: ISO 639-2 code as used on discs, e.g. "deu", "eng".

folder.description: At least one of video/audio/images must be true. ids must be unique. Only media files (videos, music, pictures) are ever shown.

name.description: Shown on the tile. No control characters, no leading/trailing spaces.

path.description: Absolute path without '.', '..' or empty segments (a trailing '/' is not allowed except for '/').

website.description: Pages are limited to the website's domain (see src/sites.rs); media, scripts and embedded players may come from anywhere except local addresses. ids are unique (shared with nothing else).

name.description: Shown on the tile. No control characters, no leading/trailing spaces.

url.description: Start page: http(s):// with a public domain name (no IP address, no localhost/.local), no user name or password.

allow_subdomains.description: Allow the domain without leading www. and all its subdomains; otherwise only exactly the start host.

show_logo.description: Show the website's own logo on the tile. The admin interface fetches it (largest icon of the page: web app manifest, apple-touch-icon, icon links, og:image, favicon) into $XDG_CACHE_HOME/curator/logos/<id>.img; otherwise the generic website icon.

homeScreen.description: One home screen, like a profile: its own items and time limits.

id.description: Key of this home screen's usage data.

name.description: Short title (menus on the TV, admin panel). No control characters, no leading/trailing spaces.

default.description: Exactly one home screen is the default (star): shown at the start and preselected in the admin panel.

home.description: The media center's home screen. Missing fields take their defaults.

title.description: Shown in the top-left corner. No control characters, no leading/trailing spaces.

language.description: Language of the media center's interface: auto = the computer's language (LANGUAGE / LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG), English if it isn't available; en = English; de = German.

discs.description: DVD/Blu-ray playback. Missing fields take their defaults.

enabled.description: Show the disc tile as usable at all.

allow_disc_menu.description: Offer "Disc menu" (regular start with the disc's own menus).

audio_languages.description: Preferred audio languages, most preferred first.

subtitle_languages.description: Preferred subtitle languages, most preferred first. Empty: no subtitles.

folders.description: Folders shown in the "Folders" row. Always accessed read-only. Ids are unique across all home screens.

websites.description: Websites shown in the "Websites" row, each opened in a locked-down fullscreen browser window. Ids are unique across all home screens.

games.description: The "Games" row of the home screen: built-in games. Missing fields take their defaults.

pong.description: Ping Pong for 1 player (against the computer) or 2 players; gamepads, remote or keyboard.

enabled.description: Show the game in the "Games" row.

computer_level.description: How well the computer plays in the 1-player game.

bricks.description: Brick Breaker: a paddle, a ball and walls of bricks; 32 stages including bonus stages.

enabled.description: Show the game in the "Games" row.

lives.description: Paddles at the start of a game (more are earned with points, up to 9).

sound.description: Sound on at the start; can be switched in the game's menu.

blocks.description: Block Stacker: falling blocks for 1 player, or 2 players side by side.

enabled.description: Show the game in the "Games" row.

start_level.description: Start level preselected in the game's menu.

sound.description: Sound on at the start; can be switched in the game's menu.

limits.description: If several rules of the same kind match a day, the most specific wins: today > weekdays > this_week > every_day. A this_week budget counts the whole week.
